title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, Grafana dashboard panels, and alert tuning
description: This PR adds token-level KV cache metrics, new Grafana dashboard panels for token cost/latency/KV breakdown, and updates alert thresholds based on recent production signal analysis. Motivation: teams have asked for clearer visibility into per-token cost and KV cache effectiveness (hit/miss latency and cost contribution) to diagnose regressions and optimize routing/batching policies. Changes include new Prometheus metrics (redwood_kv_cache_token_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_token_misses_total, redwood_token_cost_cents_total, redwood_token_latency_ms_bucketed), tagging by route and model_variant, and a dashboard JSON with panels for token cost distribution, KV hit rate over time, per-route cost/latency heatmap, and top paths causing high token cost. Alert tuning: lowered SLO alert threshold for KV miss rate from 8% to 5% for high-priority routes, added a burn-rate style alert for token-cost spike (5x baseline over 15m) and a sustained latency alert for tail tokens (p95 > 120ms for 10m). Checklist: - instrumentation added and unit-tested; - dashboard JSON exported and reviewed with observability team; - alert playbook updated with runbook links and rollback steps; - rollout gated with a canary and gradual squad opt-in. Related work: ENG-2345 (token observability epic) and prior PRs on token-level dashboards.
